Process

How We Deliver

Web Design Lane works remotely-first with Maryland clients, which means faster turnarounds and no travel costs padding the invoice.

Discovery

A call to understand your business, your market and what the site actually needs to achieve.

Strategy & Planning

A written plan with scope, timeline, deliverables and the measures we will judge the result against.

Design & Build

Design and development with regular reviews, so you see the work as it develops rather than at the end.

Launch & Support

Testing, refinement and launch, followed by ongoing support to keep the site current.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you work across Maryland?

Yes, statewide and across the wider DC metro area. We work remotely-first, so distance is not a factor.

Can you build accessible websites?

Yes. We build to WCAG standards, which matters especially for contractors and professional firms here.

Can you build a secure client portal?

Yes. Portals with document exchange and role-based access are a regular part of our work.

How long does a project take?

Usually six to ten weeks for a business site, longer where a portal or integrations are involved.
